whyLines: Context-window budget for agent tool results: unbounded file/dir dumps blow prompt tokens and latency. 2000 lines is a practical soft ceiling so the model still sees useful head content without flooding the turn.
whyBytes: 50KB caps pathological long-line files (minified/binary-as-text) that would hit few lines but huge tokens. Independent of line limit — whichever fires first wins.

removalOptions.summary: Expose PI_TOOL_MAX_LINES / PI_TOOL_MAX_BYTES (or harness flag) defaulting to official 2000/50KB
removalOptions.risk: low — schema unchanged; callers opt in

removalOptions.summary: Optional maxLines/maxBytes on tool params; omit = official defaults
removalOptions.risk: medium — schema shape grows; must stay optional for A/B embed
high — silently changes semantics; agent OOM/context blowup

removalOptions.summary: Keep caps but add continuation tokens (already partly in read notices)
removalOptions.risk: low — behavioral extension, not silent change
